cores.name: Boneyard Marauder
cores.textbox: As an additional cost to play this, banish 3 random cards from your graveyard.{br}**Blood Debt**

faces.printed_rules_text:
As an additional cost to play Boneyard Marauder, banish 3 random cards from your graveyard.
**Blood Debt** _(At the beginning of your end phase, if Boneyard Marauder is in your banished zone, lose 1{h}.)_
faces.printed_flavor_text: _"It's amazing what you can find when you dig a little deeper." - Harland_
